visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue baseball cap and black T-shirt sits at a long wooden desk in a brightly lit office, repeatedly and forcefully slamming his smartphone onto the table surface. The room contains a white projector screen and office chairs. (2) A close-up shot features a hand holding a black, circular electronic accessory labeled with the 'MOZTECH' logo against the blurred office background. (3) The man from the first phase is joined by another man wearing a grey hoodie and a black cap; both lean in to look at the smartphone. (4) The man in the grey hoodie presses the circular device against a glass partition; a small screen on the device indicates a vacuum seal. He then sticks his phone to it, which stays in place without support. A large white question mark appears. (5) Both men engage in a synchronized, rhythmic dance routine facing the camera in the middle of the office. They perform repetitive arm gestures and body sways. (6) The scene shifts to a view through the glass door, showing the phone mounted high on the glass while the two men continue their energetic dancing in the background. (7) A large graphic overlay appears on the screen, detailing a product promotion with pricing and dates while the men continue to dance behind the text.
